hunks.baseline: Hong Jin fixed a cold stare on the golden armor blocking his way.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin stared hard at the golden armor blocking his way.

hunks.baseline: His voice, usually high and gentle as a woman’s, had sunk lower than anyone had ever heard it.
hunks.sol: His voice, usually as high and gentle as a woman’s, had sunk lower than anyone had ever heard it.

hunks.baseline: The dozens of Embroidered Uniform Guards looked at one another, their faces stiff.
hunks.sol: The several dozen Embroidered Uniform Guards looked at one another, their faces stiff.

hunks.baseline: They said no matter how high you climbed, power never lasted ten years, and no flower stayed red for ten days. But things were different when you were talking about the East Depot’s former Investigating Eunuch, who had once enjoyed the late Emperor’s favor.
hunks.sol: They said power never lasted ten years, and no flower stayed red for ten days. But things were different when it came to the East Depot’s former Investigating Eunuch, who had once enjoyed the late Emperor’s favor.

hunks.baseline: Besides, plenty of old officials still remained at court, and Hong Jin had surely built up ties with them over the years.
hunks.sol: Besides, plenty of old officials still remained at court, and Hong Jin surely had ties with them.

hunks.baseline: Whether those ties were friendships forged as fellow servants of the late Emperor or secrets he’d seized as a power broker who’d once controlled the East Depot, no one could say. But one thing was certain.
hunks.sol: Whether those ties were friendships forged as fellow servants of the late Emperor or secrets he’d seized while holding sway over the East Depot, no one could say. But one thing was certain.

hunks.baseline: “Even after more than ten years away from the palace, a few letters are enough to send a low-ranking Embroidered Uniform Guard stationed here to the borderlands. So get the hell out of my way, if you want to keep wearing that shiny armor.”
hunks.sol: “Even after more than ten years away from the palace, a few letters are enough to send a low-ranking Embroidered Uniform Guard to the borderlands. So get the hell out of my way, if you want to keep wearing that shiny armor.”

hunks.baseline: Around four hours had passed since his young lord left to meet the Emperor.
hunks.sol: It had been two shichen since his young lord left to meet the Emperor.

hunks.baseline: He tried to suppress the unease that kept rising inside him, but he was finding it harder and harder to do so.
hunks.sol: He tried to suppress the unease that kept rising inside him, but even that was getting harder to do.

hunks.baseline: Just as Hong Jin bit down hard on his lip without realizing it—
hunks.sol: Just as Hong Jin bit down on his lip without realizing it—

hunks.baseline: A breezy voice cut in out of nowhere. Hyuk Mujin stepped in front of Hong Jin and waved the Embroidered Uniform Guards down.
hunks.sol: A breezy voice cut in out of nowhere. Hyuk Mujin stepped in front of Hong Jin and waved a hand at the Embroidered Uniform Guards.

hunks.baseline: “Come now, Comrade Hong, you should calm down too. What did these people do wrong? We underlings do what we’re told, whether they say ‘get down’ or ‘bark.’ Right?”
hunks.sol: “Come now, Comrade Hong, calm down yourself. What did these people do wrong? We underlings do what we’re told. They tell us to jump, we jump. They tell us to bark, we bark. Right?”

hunks.baseline: The Embroidered Uniform Guards frowned, unsure whether he was taking their side or calling them sons of bitches to their faces. Hyuk Mujin didn’t give them time to think it over before continuing.
hunks.sol: The Embroidered Uniform Guards frowned, unsure whether he was taking their side or calling them sons of bitches to their faces. Hyuk Mujin didn’t give them time to think it over.

hunks.baseline: “Still, could you at least find out what’s going on? We’re all exhausted as it is. If you make this difficult, nobody’s going to have a good time. Right?”
hunks.sol: “Still, could you at least find out what’s going on? We’re tired enough as it is. If you make this difficult, nobody’s going to have a good time. Right?”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, you’ll check? Wow! The Embroidered Uniform Guard! The pride of the Great Nation! The guardians of the imperial family! Thanks a fucking lot! If you get the time, drop by the Hyuk Family Textile Shop in the center of the imperial capital. Give them my name and you can get a discount.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, you’ll check? Wow! The Embroidered Uniform Guard! The pride of the Great Nation! The guardians of the imperial family! Thanks a fucking lot! If you get the time, drop by the Hyuk Family Textile Shop in the center of the Imperial Capital. Give them my name and you can get a discount.”

hunks.baseline: There was no chance to reply. Without waiting for the guards’ answer, Hyuk Mujin quickly turned around, grabbed Hong Jin, and backed away.
hunks.sol: There was no chance to reply. Without waiting for the guards’ answer, Hyuk Mujin turned, grabbed Hong Jin, and hurried him away.

hunks.baseline: He spoke in a low whisper.
hunks.sol: Then he whispered so quietly only Hong Jin could hear.

hunks.baseline: Those words didn’t make the unease in Hong Jin’s heart disappear, but they were enough to make him remember something he’d briefly forgotten.
hunks.sol: Those words didn’t make Hong Jin’s unease disappear, but they were enough to remind him of the reality he’d briefly forgotten.

hunks.baseline: He wouldn’t touch the body, let alone the head. And reaching the owner holding the hunting dogs’ leashes was out of the question.
hunks.sol: He wouldn’t touch the body, let alone the head. Reaching the owner holding the hunting dogs’ leashes was out of the question.

hunks.baseline: Now was the time to hide his claws and sheath his fangs.
hunks.sol: Now was the time to hide his claws and bare neither fang.

hunks.baseline: Of course, while his head had cooled, his heart was still pounding wildly.
hunks.sol: Of course, though his head had cooled, his heart was still pounding wildly.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve been following the Captain around and going through all kinds of things with him. There’s never been a problem he couldn’t solve by getting involved himself.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve followed the Captain through all kinds of trouble. Whenever he’s stepped in to handle something himself, he’s found a way to settle it.”

hunks.baseline: “No matter how badly things got twisted, in the end, the Captain swept everything away. All those bastards who strutted around bragging about being masters or the masterminds behind it all went off to interview with Yama.”
hunks.sol: “No matter how badly things got tangled, in the end, the Captain swept it all away. All those bastards who strutted around claiming to be masters or secret masterminds went off to interview with Yama.”

hunks.baseline: “Martial artist Hyuk, I’m sorry, but I’ll be blunt about this. The imperial palace is practically a living monster. No matter how skilled a Supreme Peak master Young Master Jin is…”
hunks.sol: “Martial artist Hyuk, I’m sorry, but I’ll be blunt. The imperial palace is practically a living monster. No matter how skilled a Supreme Peak master Young Master Jin is…”

hunks.baseline: “Not his martial arts. The man himself. He’s just a strong person, period. That’s the kind of person the Captain is.”
hunks.sol: “Not his martial arts. The man himself is strong. That’s the kind of person the Captain is.”

hunks.baseline: “Even if the palace is crawling with masters a level or two above him, they still won’t be able to handle the Captain. It makes no sense at all, but that’s how the Captain I know has always been.”
hunks.sol: “Even if the palace is crawling with masters a level or two above him, they still won’t be able to handle the Captain. It makes no sense, but that’s how the Captain I know has always been.”

hunks.baseline: Hong Jin was struck speechless. Then he suddenly understood.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin was struck speechless. Then he understood.

hunks.baseline: When he’d first received a secret letter from Ma Sanbao saying the Embroidered Uniform Guard was on the move, why had Jin Taekyung been the first person to come to mind?
hunks.sol: When he’d first received Ma Sanbao’s secret letter saying the Embroidered Uniform Guard was on the move, why had Jin Taekyung been the first person to come to mind?

hunks.baseline: Even though Li Feng and Hong Jin had briefly been at odds, Li Feng had spent years offering unwavering loyalty to Prince Shangshan, who’d long been left with no support.
hunks.sol: Though Li Feng and Hong Jin had briefly been at odds, Li Feng had remained unwaveringly loyal to Prince Shangshan for years, even when the prince had been all but cast adrift.

hunks.baseline: Compared to that, Hong Jin’s relationship with Jin Taekyung… calling it mutual trust was a little embarrassing.
hunks.sol: Compared to that, calling Hong Jin’s relationship with Jin Taekyung one of mutual trust was a little embarrassing.

hunks.baseline: Why had he asked for Jin Taekyung, when he could have brought along a proven loyalist or another master from the martial world?
hunks.sol: Why had he asked for Jin Taekyung when he could have brought a proven loyalist or another master from the martial world?

hunks.baseline: “You’re right, Martial artist Hyuk. I’d foolishly forgotten for a moment. I must have let my emotions get the better of me.”
hunks.sol: “You’re right, Martial artist Hyuk. I’d foolishly forgotten for a moment. I let my emotions get the better of me.”

hunks.baseline: Hong Jin answered with a little laugh.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin gave a small laugh.

hunks.baseline: “Oh. An imugi. That’s right. I was there, too. At first I thought I was dreaming, but after a while I realized it wasn’t a dream. Well, it didn’t fly through the sky, so it definitely wasn’t a dragon—it was an imugi.”
hunks.sol: “Oh. An imugi. That’s right. I was there, too. At first I thought I was dreaming, but after a while I realized I wasn’t. Well, it didn’t fly through the sky, so it definitely wasn’t a dragon. It was an imugi.”

hunks.baseline: “By the way, what piece of shit leaked that information? That was supposed to have been handled quietly, under the strictest secrecy.”
hunks.sol: “By the way, what piece of shit leaked that information? We handled it quietly, under the strictest secrecy.”

hunks.baseline: Still reeling as if time had stopped, Hong Jin realized that everything Hyuk Mujin had said earlier had been true—every last word.
hunks.sol: Still reeling as if time had stopped, Hong Jin realized that everything Hyuk Mujin had said earlier had been true. Every last word.

hunks.baseline: Just as Hong Jin stood frozen with his mouth hanging open, Hyuk Mujin, who’d been cursing the rumor-monger for some time, cautiously spoke up.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin stood frozen with his mouth hanging open. Hyuk Mujin spent a while cursing whoever had sold the story, then spoke up cautiously.

hunks.baseline: Hong Jin whipped his head around. His eyes widened like saucers when he saw who it was, while Hyuk Mujin, who’d been trying to strike a quiet deal, cried out on instinct.
hunks.sol: He whipped his head around, his eyes widening like saucers when he saw who it was. Hyuk Mujin, caught trying to strike a quiet deal, cried out on instinct.

hunks.baseline: Hong Jin rubbed his eyes with his sleeve again and again, but only one person came back toward him.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin rubbed his eyes with his sleeve again and again, but only one person was coming toward him.

hunks.baseline: Something had definitely happened. That cruel Emperor’s hand had finally reached his lord.
hunks.sol: Something had happened. That cruel Emperor’s hand had finally reached his lord.

hunks.baseline: But Hong Jin forced himself to hold back the haze gathering before his eyes.
hunks.sol: But Hong Jin fought back the haze gathering before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: And as if to answer Hong Jin’s hopes, Jin Taekyung—who’d nearly knocked the Embroidered Uniform Guards, standing firm as iron towers, flying with a shoulder-check—moved his lips.
hunks.sol: And as if to answer Hong Jin’s hopes, Jin Taekyung—who had nearly sent the Embroidered Uniform Guards flying as he shouldered through their iron-tower formation—moved his lips.

hunks.baseline: Of course, he didn’t forget to smack his one loyal subordinate on the back of the head as he passed.
hunks.sol: Of course, he didn’t forget to smack his one loyal subordinate on the back of the head in the moment he had to spare.

hunks.baseline: After returning to the pavilion, I used my internal energy to soundproof the place, then quickly laid out what had happened.
hunks.sol: Back at the pavilion, I used my internal energy to soundproof the place, then quickly laid out what had happened.

hunks.baseline: As briefly as possible, just the essentials.
hunks.sol: As briefly as possible. Just the essentials.

hunks.baseline: My summary was over—successful enough that even a twenty-first-century summary junkie, who treated their eyes and the scroll wheel as mere decorations, would’ve given it a passing grade. Hong Jin’s expression had changed with every sentence; now all that remained was unconcealable shock.
hunks.sol: That wrapped up my summary. Even the twenty-first-century summary junkies who treated their eyes and scroll wheels as mere decorations would’ve given it a passing grade. Hong Jin’s expression had changed with every point; now all that remained was unconcealable shock.

hunks.baseline: I took a deep breath and asked again.
hunks.sol: I took a deep breath.
